policy: All base test methods remain unless listed in replacements. Each replacement preserves the old observable risk while assigning it to narrower module/layer ownership.

test_multistage_task_pause_restart_and_c.reason: Separate protocol conformance from lifecycle resilience instead of multiplying the complete lifecycle by both protocols.

test_resolve_commit_and_dirty_guard_are_.reason: Split Git identity, dirty-worktree, and fail-closed selection behavior into focused repository runner/premerge tests.

test_cache_is_git_local_and_bound_to_can.reason: Replace whole-premerge cache assertions with exact scope/head/base/selection identity coverage.

test_matching_cache_skips_checks_and_for.reason: Separate affected/full cache isolation from force invalidation.

test_application_mutations_share_admissi.reason: Replace one cross-domain table with module-owned dispatch/admission tests so unrelated providers no longer couple parameter lists.
